subtitle: Your substrate, in your pocket
promotionalText: Your whole substrate, as a native app: records, agents, approvals and settings.
description:
The Substrate console is your substrate, the personal server you run or choose, in a native app for iPhone, iPad and Mac.

• Browse and search your records, by kind
• Your agents, their runs and what they ask you to approve
• The apps you have approved, and what each may do
• Your server's settings, packages and providers

The console is a client for a substrate: sign in with your server's address and approve the console's access on your server's own page.
